prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore with workspace-scoped authorization and position restoration, added Undo action support to toasts and the Episodes page delete flow in English and Korean, updated CHANGELOG.md, and added backend tests.

+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening night"):

+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, order, **kwargs):
+    payload = {
+        "episode_id": episode_id,
+        "cut_order": order,
+        "script": kwargs.get("script", f"Cut {order} script"),
+        "selected_layout": kwargs.get("selected_layout", "wide"),
+        "aspect_ratio": kwargs.get("aspect_ratio", "16:9"),
+        "dialogues": kwargs.get("dialogues", [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": f"Line {order}"}]),
+        "image_path": kwargs.get("image_path"),
+    }
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+
+    update_fields = {}
+    if "appearing_characters" in kwargs:
+        update_fields["appearing_characters"] = kwargs["appearing_characters"]
+    if "refer_prev_cut" in kwargs:
+        update_fields["refer_prev_cut"] = kwargs["refer_prev_cut"]

+        u = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}", headers=headers, json=update_fields)

+    return cut

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening night"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, order, **kwargs):
+    payload = {
+        "episode_id": episode_id,
+        "cut_order": order,
+        "script": kwargs.get("script", f"Cut {order} script"),
+        "selected_layout": kwargs.get("selected_layout", "wide"),
+        "aspect_ratio": kwargs.get("aspect_ratio", "16:9"),
+        "dialogues": kwargs.get("dialogues", [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": f"Line {order}"}]),
+        "image_path": kwargs.get("image_path"),
+    }
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if "appearing_characters" in kwargs:
+        u = client.put(
+            f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={"appearing_characters": kwargs["appearing_characters"]},
+        )
+        assert u.status_code == 200, u.text
+        cut = u.json()
+    return cut
+

+def test_restore_episode_returns_with_cuts_at_original_place(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3, summary="Third")
+
+    img_path = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier=ep2["id"])
+    cut1 = _create_cut(

+        h,

+        script="Mina waits at the stop.",
+        selected_layout="vertical",
+        aspect_ratio="9:16",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Where is it?"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "c1", "name": "Mina"}],
+        image_path=img_path,
+    )
+    cut2 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        2,
+        script="Headlights appear.",
+        selected_layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[],
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/ep2-cut2.png",
+    )
+
+    # Delete middle episode -> gap closes

+    listed_after_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_after_delete] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_after_delete] == [1, 2]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json() == []
+
+    # Restore ep2 -> returns at position 2, ep3 shifts back to 3, cuts come back

+    restored_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()

+def test_restore_first_last_and_clamped_positions(client):

+
+    # Delete first episode and restore -> returns at 1, rest move down to 2, 3
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    r1 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r1.status_code == 200, r1.text
+    assert r1.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Delete last episode (3), then delete episode 2 -> only ep1 remains (order 1).
+    # Restoring ep3 (old order 3) clamps to 2 so there is no gap.
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    r3 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r3.status_code == 200, r3.text
+    assert r3.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2]
+
+    # Now restore ep2 (old order 2) -> goes at 2, ep3 shifts to 3
+    r2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r2.status_code == 200, r2.text
+    assert r2.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Other project is unaffected
+    other_listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={other_project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in other_listed] == [other_ep["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in other_listed] == [1]
